name: Bicsérd (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of red, white and yellow in the ratio 2:1:2, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Bicsérd (a blue shield with two white ploughshares and the name BICSÉRD on its chief).
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
